metadata.title: Free JavaScript Regex Tester

regexTester.title: Regex Tester

errors.worker: The regex Worker could not start. Try again in an up-to-date browser.

reference.title: JavaScript regex quick reference
reference.description: Based on the current browser's JavaScript RegExp syntax.

characters.title: Character classes
characters.items:
. any character
\d digit · \w word character
\s whitespace · [abc] set

quantifiers.title: Quantifiers
quantifiers.items:
* zero or more · + one or more
? zero or one
'{n}' exactly n · '{n,m}' range

lookaround.title: Lookaround
lookaround.items:
(?=...) positive ahead
(?!...) negative ahead
(?<=...) positive behind

regexTester.privacy: Privacy: your pattern, test string, and replacement are processed only inside a browser Worker and are never uploaded or stored.
